connections.description: External connections, one values layer per connection file. Not used by this chart.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

dev.title: Development mode
dev.description: Unsealed in-memory server with root token "root": the store is emptied on every restart. Sandbox only.

ingressHost.title: Ingress host
ingressHost.description: Host name, the platform ingress suffix is appended.

protected.title: Protected
protected.description: Label the Vault StatefulSet and the injector okdp.io/protected=true: the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy of the tools chart refuses to delete them.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream chart this chart renders, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

vault.title: vault
vault.description: Values of the vault chart 0.34.1 (https://helm.releases.hashicorp.com), for example server.resources, server.ha, server.dataStorage, injector, nodeSelector, tolerations. Refused: fullnameOverride, nameOverride, server.dev, server.service.port, server.ingress.enabled/ingressClassName/hosts/tls (and global).

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
